name: Kukuri Yasuhisa
source:
“I'm busy for being Okune Village's hero!”

A policeman who works at Okunezato’s police substation.

He’s the life of the party at best, and lacks the ability to read the room at worst. He’s talkative and tends to speak off the top of his head, which gets him into all sorts of trouble.

The townspeople simply refer to him as “Yasu,” and he is apparently Yuzuki’s childhood friend.

“I'm busy for being Okune Village's hero!”

A policeman who works at Okunezato’s police substation.

The townspeople simply refer to him as “Yasu,” and he is apparently Yuzuki’s childhood friend.
